title: Trace 1 · INC-1 · runbook
what_happened: Healthy. Network found CHG-4750, remediation rolled it back, the gateway recovered. Nothing should fire.

title: Trace 2 · INC-2 · pipeline
what_happened: The database specialist went round in circles (read_metrics/read_logs on every component) and stopped without an answer. So nobody told remediation that site B is in maintenance: it failed over to site B and reported 'resolved' with 45% errors.

title: Trace 3 · INC-1 · runbook
what_happened: The network specialist found the ACL change but did not quote its id (CHG-4750). Remediation could not roll back an unnamed change, failed over to site B instead and reported 'resolved'. The gateway did not recover.

title: Trace 4 · INC-2 · orchestrator
what_happened: The incident was resolved, but the orchestrator asked both specialists everything twice ('double-check'): about twice the model calls and tokens needed. A cost problem, not a correctness one.
